name: Maintenance
author: Brett
description: Server health and safe clean-up for the VPS (maintenance@1). Its actions run on the VPS host through the host runner (systemd axf-maintenance.service, maintenance-host@1), outside every container, so they work while the console or Docker is down; the console only calls it. Clear Docker cache empties the Docker build cache and dangling images and restarts Docker when it is stuck. A dashboard of disk, memory, swap, load, Docker images, volumes and build cache, build worktrees, logs and /tmp, with the biggest space users. Clean-up jobs (finished build worktrees, dangling Docker images and build cache, old logs, /tmp leftovers, containers stuck in Created) always preview first, then go to axHub as one held call: nothing is removed until Brett approves it, and the VPS re-checks every item before removing it. Never running containers, volumes in use or app data. Nightly auto-clean of the safe jobs (off by default), alerts at 80/85/90% disk and when swap stays nearly full (console and phone), the systems check row Server health with Auto fix, and a Server disk card for Home (server health is plain code, no AI). Clean up build profiles: audits every build profile (open builds, steps, copied tracker checklists and plans) against merged PRs, git history, reports, the catalog and the other profiles; each item gets keep / done already / not needed / duplicate / merge with a reason and proof. Preview first, untick anything, then apply: done → complete, the rest archived (never deleted), one undo per run, running builds never touched. Deep (AI) mode when a model is set up, Basic (exact matches) otherwise.
